title: Pastry Café
summary: The pastry café serves pastries, and the player may go to the café to buy a snack due to being hungry. If the player chooses the option that leads to to the cafe, the player hears a suspicious sound again. After that, the player returns to the street from where the noise was heard.

The '''pastry café''' serves pastries, and the player may go to the café to buy a snack due to being hungry. If the player chooses the option that leads to to the cafe, the player hears a suspicious sound again. After that, the player returns to the street from where the noise was heard. {{source|Huntik.com/Adventure Game#Chapter 1|Adventure Game}}
